summary.plain: The physicists who ran the DONUT experiment at Fermilab in 1997 and, in 2001, published the first direct observation of tau-neutrino interactions.
summary.technical: DONUT (Fermilab E872) Collaboration; operated the tau-neutrino emulsion detector at Fermilab in 1997 and published the first direct observation of tau-neutrino interactions in 2001 (Phys. Lett. B 504, 218).
